typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ReportName as string ('pfoxd105d vSphere World'),
	vmrightsizing0_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Name as string,
		MORef as string,
		vCenter as string,
		{CPU Provisioned (vCPU)} as string,
		{CPU Recommended (vCPU)} as string,
		{CPU Demand % (Peak)} as string,
		{CPU Demand % (P95)} as string,
		{CPU Usage % (Peak)} as string,
		{CPU Usage % (P95)} as string,
		{Mem Provisioned (GB)} as string,
		{Mem Recommended (GB)} as string,
		{Mem Usage % (Peak)} as string,
		{Mem Usage % (p95)} as string,
		{Creation Date} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> VMRIGHTSIZING
VMRIGHTSIZING derive(report_name = toString($ReportName),
		importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Name as string,
		Mem_Provisioned__GB_ as string,
		MORef as string,
		CPU_Demand____P95_ as string,
		CPU_Usage____Peak_ as string,
		CPU_Usage____P95_ as string,
		Mem_Usage____Peak_ as string,
		Creation_Date as string,
		Mem_Recommended__GB_ as string,
		Mem_Usage____p95_ as string,
		vCenter as string,
		report_name as string,
		CPU_Recommended__vCPU_ as string,
		CPU_Provisioned__vCPU_ as string,
		CPU_Demand____Peak_ as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Name,
		Mem_Provisioned__GB_ = {Mem Provisioned (GB)},
		MORef,
		CPU_Demand____P95_ = {CPU Demand % (P95)},
		CPU_Usage____Peak_ = {CPU Usage % (Peak)},
		CPU_Usage____P95_ = {CPU Usage % (P95)},
		Mem_Usage____Peak_ = {Mem Usage % (Peak)},
		Creation_Date = {Creation Date},
		Mem_Recommended__GB_ = {Mem Recommended (GB)},
		Mem_Usage____p95_ = {Mem Usage % (p95)},
		vCenter,
		report_name,
		CPU_Recommended__vCPU_ = {CPU Recommended (vCPU)},
		CPU_Provisioned__vCPU_ = {CPU Provisioned (vCPU)},
		CPU_Demand____Peak_ = {CPU Demand % (Peak)}),
	partitionFileNames:[($vmrightsizing0_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> vmrightsizing0
